selector.champion: Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS)
selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of an asymptomatic, arc-shaped, depressed skin groove with localized linear hair loss and hair thinning, along with histopathologic findings of lymphocytic infiltrates and hyaline fat necrosis, supports LALPS. Positive direct immunofluorescence with granular deposition of immunoglobulins and complement components in dermal blood vessels further supports this diagnosis.

registry.preferred_name: Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS)
support_spans: asymptomatic, arc-shaped, depressed skin groove on the left side of his forehead, frontal scalp, and vertex area
Localized linear hair loss and hair thinning on the left scalp area
inflammatory infiltrates between adipocytes with hyaline fat necrosis in the subcutis
Direct immunofluorescence: Positive with granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels
contradict_spans: The patient denied any trauma history and had no history of connective tissue disease nor any evidence of systemic involvement, such as arthralgia, photosensitivity, or skin rashes
